title: Activepieces Self Hosted Pricing: Plans and Costs 2026
summary: Activepieces self-hosted pricing charges per credit: Free has 1,000/month, Plus is $20 for 10,000, Team is $200 for 50,000.
body_markdown:
## Frequently asked questions


After a prepared sales call, four small questions are left, and each has a short answer.


Is self-hosted Activepieces free? Yes, the Community Edition is the MIT-licensed core and carries no licence fee, with unlimited flows as on every plan, so your cost is the servers, storage and engineering time needed to run it.


A self-hosted paid licence is a different product. It's quoted by sales, and the quote depends on user count, credit volume, deployment setup and the level of support you want.


Does Team include SSO? Yes, SSO is part of the Team plan. A team that needs single sign-on and fits within Team's user and credit limits can buy it self-serve from the pricing page.


If your identity requirements go beyond what Team covers, or you need to run self-hosted with enterprise controls, that moves to a sales conversation.


### What happens when I exceed my credits?


Past your plan's allowance, usage is billed per credit at a metered overage rate, which is published on the pricing page. The credit is the unit being counted, so the useful check is how many credits your busiest workflows burn in a month.


Compare the overage on that volume with the cost of the next plan up. If you regularly go over, the higher plan is usually cheaper than paying overage every month.


### How much does Activepieces Embed cost?


Embed is quoted by sales and is priced as an annual contract, not a monthly self-serve plan. It applies when you're putting automation inside your own product for your customers, rather than using it internally.


How many customers or users you expect to serve, the credit volume behind them, how you deploy it and the support you need all move the quote. Bring those four numbers to the call.
